data.title: SpaceX’s Starlink Mobile plans are pressuring AT&T and Verizon shares
data.summary_raw: SpaceX plans to purchase Grain Management’s 800 MHz spectrum portfolio in a move to bolster its mobile ambitions. The news is lifting cell-tower stocks.

data.title: Micron, Nvidia and AI chip stocks fall as report on OpenAI’s revenue causes ‘undue concern’
data.summary_raw: OpenAI’s annualized revenue reportedly fell short of expectations — but analysts say that reflects differences in how the figure is reported, not weakness in AI demand.

data.title: Why a longtime skeptic of Palantir’s stock is finally saying it’s time to buy
data.summary_raw: Palantir’s total addressable market could get a lot bigger, while its business model should sustain its lead against competitors, an analyst says
